build_Pointnet2Backbone: build a Pointnet2Backbone network for point cloud feature learning with configurable input feature dimensions
run_Pointnet2Backbone_forward: run a forward pass of Pointnet2Backbone on a batch of point clouds to extract multi-scale features
build_SparseConvBackbone: build a SparseConvBackbone network using MinkowskiEngine sparse convolutions for 3D point cloud feature extraction
run_SparseConvBackbone_forward: run a forward pass of SparseConvBackbone on sparse tensor inputs to extract and downsample features
review_Pointnet2Backbone_break_up_pc: review the Pointnet2Backbone _break_up_pc method that splits point clouds into xyz coordinates and features
